isolation: cell-scoped tables; authenticated tenant/workspace/environment/object checks on every access
encryption: KMS at rest; sensitive bodies encrypted in scoped S3, not copied into indexes
ttl: application enforces expiry; unresolved accepted work must not expire silently

tables.name: CommandJournal
tables.write: conditional create; same key/different hash conflicts
tables.recovery: Streams publisher plus durable sparse pending index

tables.name: MessageTimeline
tables.read: bounded cursor; bucket/shard merge for hot conversations

tables.name: MessageLookup
tables.read: strong base-table read where authority/correctness needs it

tables.name: StatusEvidence
tables.write: append distinct facts; never regress delivered/read because a late sent arrives

tables.name: ActionState
tables.write: conditional claim and expected-version update; UNKNOWN is not a new action

tables.name: DedupReceipt
tables.write: effect and dedup marker cross same local durability boundary

tables.name: WebhookDelivery
tables.write: durable record before POST; retry keeps delivery_id; replay creates new delivery_id

pending_indexes: CommandJournal: cell + pending_shard + due_time_bucket; SK due_at + command_id
WebhookDelivery: cell + endpoint_hash + due_time_bucket; SK next_due + delivery_id
backup: PITR and independent permitted-region/account backups; measured restore plus erasure replay required
